name: maxey0-ss
title: Maxey0 for Claude Desktop
description: Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

authentication.note: The edge forwards Authorization verbatim and terminates it at the origin. The live origin rejects unauthenticated tools/call with a role-'public' permission error; maxey0-ss.auth.manifest reports admin_open only if MAXEY0_AUTH_MODE=disabled without MAXEY0_PUBLIC=1.
